THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Strawberry Brownie Cheesecake Snack Box

Snack Box Series Ep. 12 — dessert-inspired kid snack box: Oikos Triple Zero strawberry yogurt, Prime Bites red velvet protein brownie, Honey Maid graham crackers, fresh strawberries. ~230 cal / 19g protein per box.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME12 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~230 cal | ~19g protein

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 2 single-serve containers Oikos Triple Zero Strawberry Greek yogurt — divided across 4 boxes; 1/2 container per box
  • 2 Prime Bites Red Velvet Protein Brownies — 1/2 brownie per box (~10g protein per half)
  • 4 Honey Maid honey graham cracker sheets — 1 sheet per box (~60 cal per sheet)
  • Fresh strawberries — hulled and cut to fill each box

Allergens: dairy, wheat, eggs — verify brownie label. Verify Prime Bites label — some protein brownie brands contain nuts, soy, or additional egg. Prime Bites Red Velvet was shown. Honey Maid graham crackers contain wheat / gluten. Confirm every packaged product label when managing a food allergy — snack box brands drift.

You want a dessert-flavored kid snack box without handing over an actual dessert plate. Strawberry Oikos Triple Zero doubles as the creamy dip (7g protein), Prime Bites red velvet protein brownie brings the fudge (10g protein per half), honey graham is the crunch, fresh strawberries carry the vehicle. 12 min flat, no cook, 2 kids covered for 2 days.

Method

  1. 1.SET UP. Line up 4 divided snack boxes. Buluker pastel 4-compartment boxes shown — the same set featured on Favorites → Snack Box Essentials.
  2. 2.STRAWBERRY YOGURT. Divide each Oikos Triple Zero container between 2 boxes — 1/2 container per box in one compartment. This is the creamy anchor + the fresh-strawberry dip.
  3. 3.FRESH STRAWBERRIES. Hull and cut fresh strawberries into kid-friendly bite pieces, then fill one compartment of each box. Strawberries + yogurt = the cheesecake half of the box.
  4. 4.HONEY GRAHAM. Place 1 Honey Maid honey graham cracker sheet in one compartment of each box. Break into smaller pieces for younger eaters if needed — the crackers stay crispest when packed WHOLE and broken at snack time.
  5. 5.RED VELVET BROWNIE. Cut each Prime Bites Red Velvet Protein Brownie in half and place one half in the remaining compartment of each box. The fudgy dessert element without a full dessert plate.
  6. 6.SEAL + CHILL. Snap lids on and refrigerate. Serve within 2 days. Transport with an ice pack for lunchbox use. Graham cracker softens in a closed box — pack a whole cracker and let the kid break it if you want crisper crunch.

Storage and reheating

Store: Refrigerate covered. Transport with an ice pack for lunchbox use.

Reheat: Don't — serve cold. That's the whole snack-box format.

Lasts: Best within 2 days. Graham cracker softens in a sealed box — pack whole and break at snack time if you want maximum crisp.

Estimated nutrition

~230 cal | ~19g protein.

~230 cal / 19g protein per snack box, approximate. Component breakdown: 1/2 Oikos Triple Zero Strawberry Greek yogurt (~45 cal / 7.5g protein) + 1/2 Prime Bites Red Velvet Protein Brownie (~90 cal / 10g protein) + 1 Honey Maid graham sheet (~60 cal / 1g protein) + fresh strawberries to fill (~30 cal / 0.5g protein). Total: ~225 cal / ~19g protein. Marked estimated — values vary by brownie brand, exact yogurt fill, and strawberry portion. Confirm exact numbers off the labels of the specific brands you pick.

Brands I use

Oikos Triple Zero
Strawberry Greek Yogurt (single-serve, ~90 cal / 15g protein per container). 1/2 container per box.
The creamy anchor + the dip for the fresh strawberries. Triple Zero = zero added sugar / zero artificial sweeteners / zero fat. Half a container per box delivers ~7.5g protein from the yogurt alone.
Prime Bites
Red Velvet Protein Brownie (~180 cal / 20g protein per full brownie). 1/2 brownie per box.
The dessert energy that doesn't turn the box into a sugar bomb. Red velvet flavor pairs with the strawberry yogurt for the cheesecake read. Half a brownie per box = ~10g protein from the brownie alone.
Honey Maid
Honey Grahams (~60 cal / 1g protein per sheet). 1 sheet per box.
The crunch layer — the graham-cracker floor of a cheesecake. Standard pantry brand, universal kid-approved flavor. Pack whole; break at snack time for maximum crisp.
Fresh Strawberries
Any grocery-store fresh strawberries — hulled and cut. ~30 cal per full compartment fill.
The vehicle for the yogurt dip + the fresh element that keeps the box from reading purely as dessert. Cut age-appropriate — whole for older kids, quartered for toddlers.
Buluker Snack Containers
Four-compartment pastel snack boxes (the exact set shown across the Snack Box Series).
Same 4-compartment containers used across every Snack Box Series entry. Yogurt, strawberries, graham, and brownie each get their own compartment so nothing soaks the graham. See Favorites → Snack Box Essentials for the honest what-to-know.
